title: Finite-stage vanishing of a fixed sheaf in affine degree zero
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse diagram of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(X,(p_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$, an abelian sheaf $F$ on the small etale site of $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $x\in H^0(D_i,F)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. If $p_i^*(x)=0$ in $H^0(X,p_i^{-1}F)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], there exist $j\in I$ and $f:i\to j$ such that $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*(x)=0$ in $H^0(D_j,D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F)$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), degree zero for the single fixed stage sheaf, using 0EYL, 04HR and Sites 09YN (lemma-colimit-sections).

proof.text: Restrict to the cofinal upper tail of i, without changing the limit. Its schemes and limit are affine; the latter follows from Mathlib Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit. Interpret H^0 as sections at the identity etale object, and cohomological pullback as the unit on sections.

Use the affine etale site colimit presentation and the full-affine restriction equivalence. Compare inverse images through their sectionwise right adjoints and units. Inverse-image composition identifies the limit pullbacks of the fixed stage sheaf with a constant diagram; the identity cocone is a colimit because the tail is connected. The section comparison in Sites 09YN identifies its sections at the identity affine object with the filtered colimit of stage sections, compatibly with units.

The zero image of x identifies its representative with zero in the filtered colimit. Detection of equality at a later stage gives the required arrow out of i. The degree-zero pullback/unit formula translates its zero section to the displayed cohomology equality.

proof_origin.place: Fixed-coefficient specialization of the section comparison on the affine upper tail; independent of varying coefficient systems and filtered sheaf colimits.
